project.description: The name of the project to add the Contentstack feature to.

debug.description: Display additional details during the running process.

apiKey.description: Contentstack stack API key (read-only, safe in a client bundle).
apiKey.x-prompt: [Contentstack] Stack API key? (leave blank to scaffold a placeholder)

deliveryToken.description: Contentstack delivery token (read-only, scoped to the environment).
deliveryToken.x-prompt: [Contentstack] Delivery token? (leave blank to scaffold a placeholder)

environment.x-prompt: [Contentstack] Environment name? (leave blank to scaffold a placeholder)

x-prompt.message: [Contentstack] Which data-center region is your stack in?

cmsPageContentType.description: The Contentstack content type resolved for content/landing routes (incl. the homepage).
cmsPageContentType.x-prompt: [Contentstack] Page content type to resolve for content routes?

occFallback.description: Hybrid mode: fall back to SAP Commerce (OCC) for any page/slot not authored in Contentstack.
occFallback.x-prompt: [Contentstack] Fall back to SAP (OCC) for content not in Contentstack? (recommended)

includeFallback.description: Fall back to master-locale content for entries not localized in the active locale.
includeFallback.x-prompt: [Contentstack] Fall back to master-locale content for untranslated entries?

livePreview.description: Enable Contentstack Live Preview / Visual Builder wiring.

previewToken.description: Contentstack preview token (used only when Live Preview is enabled).
previewToken.x-prompt: [Contentstack] Preview token? (only needed for Live Preview; leave blank to scaffold a placeholder)
